tasks.question: In the formation-evaluation notes, what two permeabilities form the definition of relative permeability?
tasks.reference_answer: Effective permeability of the specified fluid divided by absolute permeability.
expected_claims: Relative permeability is effective permeability of a fluid divided by absolute permeability.

tasks.question: 자료의 정의에 따르면 drilling 중 lost returns는 지층으로 무엇이 빠져나가는 현상인가?
tasks.reference_answer: 전량의 drilling mud가 공동, 균열 또는 고투과층으로 손실되는 현상이다.
expected_claims: Lost circulation means whole mud is lost into a formation, e.g. caverns, fractures or high-permeability beds.

tasks.question: What physical volume ratio is used to define rock porosity in the reservoir-engineering text?
tasks.reference_answer: Pore or void volume divided by bulk rock volume.
expected_claims: Porosity equals pore volume divided by bulk rock volume.

tasks.question: 시멘트 채널링이 시멘트 sheath에 남기는 결함은 무엇인가?
tasks.reference_answer: 불규칙한 mud 치환으로 casing과 borehole 사이 cement sheath에 빈 통로가 남는다.
expected_claims: Cement channeling is irregular mud displacement leaving voids in the cement sheath.

tasks.question: According to the formation-evaluation notes, which log is primarily used to distinguish shale from other formation types?
tasks.reference_answer: Gamma ray log.
expected_claims: The gamma-ray log is used to differentiate shale from other formations.

tasks.question: 가스 리프트에서 주입 가스는 보통 어느 공간으로 들어간 뒤 어떤 장치를 통해 생산 tubing으로 진입하는가?
tasks.reference_answer: 보통 tubing-casing annulus로 주입하고 특정 깊이의 gas-lift valve를 통해 생산 tubing 유동으로 들어간다.
expected_claims: Gas is normally injected into the tubing-casing annulus.
Gas enters the production-tubing flowstream through gas-lift valves at depth.

tasks.question: What two discretization choices does the simulation text identify as causes of numerical dispersion?
tasks.reference_answer: Spatial grid spacing Δx and time-step Δt discretization/truncation error.
expected_claims: Spatial discretization contributes to numerical dispersion.
Time discretization contributes to numerical dispersion.

tasks.question: 생산 기술 자료에서 slug flow의 gas와 liquid는 어떤 배열로 올라가는가?
tasks.reference_answer: 부력으로 상승하는 gas slug들이 연속적인 liquid column에 의해 분리된다.
expected_claims: Gas slugs rise by buoyancy and are separated by continuous liquid columns.

tasks.question: Explain how a high-permeability streak can change waterflood timing and what a water-drive reservoir can show at the producers after water arrives.
tasks.reference_answer: Water preferentially channels through the high-permeability streak, causing premature breakthrough; despite pressure support/productivity, oil output falls as produced water increases.
expected_claims: High-permeability layers preferentially carry injected water and can cause early breakthrough.
Water drive can maintain pressure/productivity while oil production falls as water production rises.

tasks.question: 진흙 기둥 압력이 지층 공극압보다 높은 상황에서 생기는 침입·mudcake와, lost circulation을 서로 구별해 설명해줘.
tasks.reference_answer: Overbalance는 mud filtrate가 투과성 지층으로 침입하고 입자가 borehole wall에 mudcake를 만든다. Lost circulation은 whole mud가 공동·균열·고투과층으로 빠져나가는 별도 현상이다.
expected_claims: Overbalance can force mud filtrate into permeable rock and deposit mudcake.
Lost circulation refers to whole mud losses into formation openings or permeable beds, not merely filtrate invasion.

tasks.question: Why is gas lift fundamentally different from pump-based artificial lift, and where does lift gas enter the produced stream?
tasks.reference_answer: Gas lift reduces hydrostatic lift gradient by injecting gas, usually into the annulus then through gas-lift valves into tubing; pumping supplies mechanical energy to offset tubing pressure drop.
expected_claims: Gas lift reduces the vertical hydrostatic pressure gradient rather than adding pump energy.
Gas is normally injected in the annulus and enters tubing through valves.

tasks.question: 상대투과도의 정의와 water/oil mobility ratio가 waterflood sweep에 중요한 이유를 자료 두 곳을 연결해 설명해줘.
tasks.reference_answer: 각 상의 상대투과도는 해당 상 유효투과도/절대투과도이며 포화도에 따라 변한다. 낮은 water/oil mobility ratio일수록 물-기름 치환 회수효율이 높아진다는 자료가 있다.
expected_claims: Relative permeability is phase effective permeability divided by absolute permeability and varies with saturation.
Lower water/oil mobility ratio tends to improve water/oil displacement recovery efficiency.

tasks.question: When mud hydrostatic pressure exceeds pore pressure, why can a mudcake appear on a permeable borehole wall?
tasks.reference_answer: Pressure differential drives mud filtrate into the formation while suspended solids deposit on the borehole wall and form mudcake.
expected_claims: Overbalance drives filtrate invasion into permeable rock.
Mud solids are deposited at the wall, forming mudcake.

tasks.question: 왜 이질적 waterflood에서 높은 투과도의 얇은 층이 조기 water breakthrough를 부를 수 있나?
tasks.reference_answer: 물은 고투과층으로 우선 흐르므로 평균 투과도를 가정한 예측보다 빨리 생산정에 도달할 수 있다.
expected_claims: Injected water flows preferentially through high-permeability layers.
This preferential flow can produce premature water breakthrough.

tasks.question: Why might reducing sand-face pressure through depletion or formation damage lower the water cut at which a well stops flowing naturally?
tasks.reference_answer: Depletion or damage/skin reduces well rate and makes natural lift fail at a lower critical water cut.
expected_claims: Depletion or formation-damage skin reduces the well production rate.
The critical water cut for natural flow then decreases.

tasks.question: 격자나 시간 간격에서 생기는 numerical dispersion은 waterflood 전선과 breakthrough 예측에 어떤 영향을 주는가?
tasks.reference_answer: 수치적 truncation error가 홍수 전선을 비물리적으로 퍼뜨려 조기 breakthrough 등 오차를 만든다.
expected_claims: Grid/time discretization can spread a displacement front numerically.
Such numerical spreading can lead to apparent early breakthrough.

tasks.question: Compare the meaning of net pay thickness and gross reservoir thickness in a net-to-gross ratio.
tasks.reference_answer: Net pay is the interval contributing to flow, gross is the full reservoir interval; net-to-gross is net pay thickness divided by total/gross thickness.
expected_claims: Net pay is the portion contributing to flow.
Net-to-gross is net pay thickness divided by total/gross thickness.

tasks.question: How do the oil formation volume factor and the shrinkage factor relate in the text?
tasks.reference_answer: The shrinkage factor is the reciprocal of oil formation volume factor Bo; Bo converts stock-tank oil to reservoir volume, while shrinkage converts reservoir oil to stock-tank volume.
expected_claims: Oil shrinkage factor is 1/Bo.
Bo and shrinkage convert volumes in opposite directions between surface and reservoir conditions.

tasks.question: 비교해줘: 생산 중 water drive가 지배적인 저류층과 압력이 bubble point 아래로 내려가 solution gas drive가 추가된 저류층의 GOR 징후는?
tasks.reference_answer: Water drive는 압력 지지가 좋고 GOR가 undersaturated 수준에 머물 수 있다. Bubble point 아래로 떨어져 solution gas drive가 생기면 GOR가 증가한다.
expected_claims: Water drive provides pressure support.
Below bubble point, solution-gas drive can cause gas-oil ratio to rise.

tasks.question: Contrast the mechanism of gas lift with that of pumping for artificial lift, without claiming they have identical effects on the tubing gradient.
tasks.reference_answer: Gas lift reduces hydrostatic head by adding gas; a pump supplies energy that offsets tubing pressure drop.
expected_claims: Gas lift reduces hydrostatic head pressure loss.
Pumps supply energy to offset pressure drop rather than use the same gas-lift mechanism.

tasks.question: Three injectors delivered 1,260, 1,410 and 1,530 bbl yesterday. Give their combined injected volume in bbl. The separator ran at 190 psi, which is irrelevant.
expected_claims: Combined injected volume is 4,200 bbl.

tasks.question: 시작 압력 3,245 psi, 종료 압력 2,930 psi일 때 압력 감소량을 계산해줘. 함께 기록된 well depth 8,600 ft는 이 차이에 쓰지 마.
tasks.reference_answer: 315 psi 감소.
expected_claims: Pressure fell by 315 psi.

tasks.question: An intervention raised oil rate from 760 to 950 stb/d. What is the percentage increase relative to the original rate? Ignore the unrelated water rate of 120 stb/d.
tasks.reference_answer: 25% increase.
expected_claims: Oil rate increased by 25% relative to 760 stb/d.

tasks.question: 생산정 네 곳의 gas rate가 18, 24, 30, 36 MMscf/d다. 중앙값만 MMscf/d로 계산해줘. 기록된 casing shoe 6,400 ft는 무관하다.
tasks.reference_answer: 중앙값은 27 MMscf/d.
expected_claims: Median of 18, 24, 30, 36 is 27 MMscf/d.

tasks.question: For a material balance ledger, produced oil is 1,475 bbl and injected water is 2,025 bbl. Report only the water-minus-oil volume difference. A porosity value of 0.22 is a distractor.
tasks.reference_answer: 550 bbl.
expected_claims: Water-minus-oil volume difference is 550 bbl.

tasks.question: Use only my expression E = area * thickness * porosity. area=2,400,000 m², thickness=14 m and porosity=0.17. What is E in m³? Do not use the unrelated 35°C temperature.
expected_claims: Using the supplied expression and operands, E is 5,712,000 m³.

tasks.question: 사용자 정의 지표 I = 2*k - 0.5*s를 계산해줘. k=37, s=8이고 I는 무차원이야. 로그에 적힌 1,200 psi는 쓰지 마.
tasks.reference_answer: I = 70 (무차원).
expected_claims: The user-defined index evaluates to 70.

tasks.question: Sweep x from 2 to 8 in steps of 2 using the supplied relation q = 12 + 3*x. List q for every x and identify the maximum. Units are arbitrary index units.
tasks.reference_answer: x=2,4,6,8 gives q=18,24,30,36 index units; maximum 36 at x=8.
expected_claims: Four cases x=2,4,6,8 are evaluated.
q values are 18,24,30,36 respectively.
Maximum q is 36 at x=8.

tasks.question: 공극률 φ를 0.12부터 0.28까지 0.04 간격으로 바꿔가며 W = 0.8*φ*V를 계산해줘. V=1,000,000 m³이고 최댓값의 φ와 W를 알려줘.
expected_claims: Five supplied-formula sweep cases are calculated.
The W values are 96000, 128000, 160000, 192000 and 224000 m³ in order.
Maximum W is 224000 m³ at φ=0.28.

tasks.question: A lab defines dimensionless C = (P1-P2)*0.004 where pressure inputs are entered in psi. P1=3,500 psi and P2=2,900 psi. Compute C, disregarding a reported depth of 4,700 ft.
tasks.reference_answer: C = 2.4, dimensionless under the supplied definition.
expected_claims: The supplied expression uses a 600 psi pressure difference.
C equals 2.4 dimensionless.

tasks.question: Find the internal porosity definition, then compute porosity when a plug has 306 cm³ pore space and 1,800 cm³ bulk volume. Cite the page containing the relationship.
tasks.reference_answer: φ=Vp/Vb=306/1800=0.17 (17%), using the porosity definition on the cited page.
expected_claims: The KB definition is pore volume divided by bulk volume.
Porosity is 0.17 or 17%.

tasks.question: Internal log notes relate Rt and Ro to water saturation through Rt=Ro/Sw². Find the equation's page and calculate Rt when Ro=7.2 ohm-m and Sw=0.40.
expected_claims: The cited KB span contains Rt=Ro/Sw².
Rt is 45 ohm-m for the supplied values.

tasks.question: Use the textbook relationship between oil formation volume factor Bo and shrinkage factor. If Bo=1.25 reservoir bbl/STB, calculate the shrinkage factor with a cited formula source.
tasks.reference_answer: Shrinkage factor=1/Bo=0.8 STB/reservoir bbl.
expected_claims: The source states shrinkage factor is reciprocal of Bo.
For Bo=1.25, shrinkage factor is 0.8 STB/reservoir bbl.

tasks.question: Using the internal definition of relative permeability, compute kr for a fluid with effective permeability 84 mD in a rock of absolute permeability 280 mD. Cite the defining span.
tasks.reference_answer: kr=84/280=0.30, dimensionless.
expected_claims: Relative permeability is effective divided by absolute permeability.
The resulting relative permeability is 0.30.

tasks.question: For a sand, the formation-evaluation text gives Humble's relation F=0.62/φ^2.15. Verify that exact source span and calculate F at φ=0.20, rounded to two decimals.
expected_claims: The cited sand-specific source contains F=0.62/φ^2.15.
At porosity 0.20, F is approximately 19.73.

tasks.question: In a permeable interval, what should happen to mud filtrate and mudcake if the mud column remains above pore pressure?
tasks.reference_answer: Overbalance drives filtrate into formation and deposits solids as a mudcake on the borehole wall.
expected_claims: Positive mud-to-pore pressure differential drives filtrate invasion.
Solids deposit at the wall as mudcake.

tasks.question: 저류층 압력이 bubble point 아래로 내려가면 water drive 단독이라고 단정해도 될까? GOR 징후를 조건부로 설명해줘.
tasks.reference_answer: 아니다. bubble point 아래에서는 solution gas drive가 추가되어 GOR가 상승할 수 있고, water drive와 함께 combination drive가 될 수 있다.
expected_claims: Pressure below bubble point can initiate solution gas drive with rising GOR.
Water drive plus solution gas drive may form combination drive.

tasks.question: If produced gas-liquid ratio is high and selecting artificial lift, what caution does the production text raise about pumping versus gas lift?
tasks.reference_answer: Gas is problematic for pumping methods; gas lift can use produced-gas energy and supplement it with injected gas, so selection must consider GLR.
expected_claims: High produced gas can present difficulties for pumping methods.
Gas lift can use produced gas energy, so GLR matters for method selection.

tasks.question: If an oil zone is produced above its water-coning critical rate, what water movement is described and which completion strategy is offered to suppress it?
tasks.reference_answer: A water cone can develop toward oil-zone perforations; the text describes producing water through anti-coning perforations below the oil-water contact and reinjecting it with an inverted ESP.
expected_claims: Production above the critical oil rate can create a water cone.
Separate anti-coning perforations with inverted ESP water reinjection can suppress the cone.

tasks.question: In volume conversion, is oil shrinkage factor another name for Bo, or its reciprocal?
tasks.reference_answer: It is the reciprocal of Bo, not Bo itself.
expected_claims: Shrinkage factor equals 1/Bo, not Bo.

tasks.question: 시멘트 channeling과 lost circulation을 같은 현상이라고 불러도 되나? 발생 위치와 유체 이동을 구별해줘.
tasks.reference_answer: 같지 않다. Channeling은 casing-borehole 사이 cement sheath의 빈 통로; lost circulation은 whole mud의 지층 손실이다.
expected_claims: Cement channeling leaves voids in the annular cement sheath.
Lost circulation is whole-mud loss into formation; it is distinct.

tasks.question: Does 'underbalanced' mean the mud hydrostatic pressure is above formation pressure? Use the drilling example's sign convention.
tasks.reference_answer: No. Underbalanced means wellbore hydrostatic pressure is below formation pressure; the cited example reports a negative overbalance and influx risk.
expected_claims: Underbalance means mud/wellbore pressure is below formation pressure.
A negative overbalance corresponds to influx risk in the drilling example.

tasks.question: Capillary pressure is just the pressure drop between two points of a single oil phase, with no fluid interface involved, 맞지?
tasks.reference_answer: 아니다. 자료의 capillary pressure는 서로 다른 유체 상의 interface를 가로지르는 압력 차이다.
expected_claims: Explicitly reject the single-phase pressure-drop premise.
Correctly identify capillary pressure as pressure difference across a fluid interface.

tasks.question: Lost circulation is formation fluid entering the borehole because mud pressure is too low, correct? Please confirm from the drilling material.
tasks.reference_answer: Incorrect. Lost circulation is loss of whole drilling mud into formation openings or permeable beds. Formation-fluid influx under low mud pressure is a different problem.
expected_claims: Explicitly reject equating lost circulation with formation-fluid influx.
Correctly define lost circulation as whole-mud loss to the formation.

tasks.question: 수치 시뮬레이션의 numerical dispersion은 격자·시간 이산화와 관계없는 실제 암석 확산이라서 grid를 바꿔도 그대로라는 주장에 동의해?
tasks.reference_answer: 동의하지 않는다. 자료의 numerical dispersion은 공간 및 시간 discretization/truncation error로 생기는 인공적인 전선 확산이다.
expected_claims: Explicitly reject the claim that numerical dispersion is independent of gridding/time stepping.
Identify spatial and temporal discretization error as the cause.

tasks.question: Gas lift and a downhole pump both work by injecting mechanical pump energy into the tubing, right?
tasks.reference_answer: No. Gas lift injects gas to reduce hydrostatic lift burden, while a pump supplies mechanical energy to offset pressure drop.
expected_claims: Explicitly reject the identical-mechanism premise.
Distinguish gas injection/reduced hydrostatic head from pump-supplied energy.

tasks.question: A reservoir has porosity 0.18. Give its exact recoverable oil volume in STB, with no other field data available.
tasks.reference_answer: Cannot calculate exact recoverable STB from porosity alone; at least reservoir geometry/volume, hydrocarbon saturation, formation volume factor and recovery assumption are missing.
expected_claims: Do not invent exact recoverable oil volume.
Identify missing reservoir volume/geometry and additional saturation/volume/recovery inputs.

tasks.question: A casing string's outside diameter is 7 in. Give the exact cement-slurry volume for primary cementing, but no hole diameter or interval length is available.
tasks.reference_answer: Cannot compute exact cement volume from casing OD alone; annular hole/casing geometry, cement interval length and excess assumptions are missing.
expected_claims: Do not fabricate a cement volume.
Identify missing annulus geometry and cemented length.

tasks.question: Oil-zone perforations are five metres above the water contact. State the exact critical oil rate for water coning without permeability, density contrast or geometry data.
tasks.reference_answer: An exact critical oil rate cannot be determined from separation alone; formation/fluid properties and completion geometry are needed.
expected_claims: Do not invent an exact coning critical rate.
Explain missing rock/fluid and completion inputs.

tasks.question: For a heterogeneous reservoir, state the unique water-breakthrough day from only its average permeability of 85 mD. No geometry, rate or saturation data are given.
tasks.reference_answer: A unique breakthrough time is not identifiable from average permeability alone; flow configuration, heterogeneity, injection/production rates and saturation behavior are missing.
expected_claims: Do not invent a breakthrough day.
Name essential missing flow/geometry/heterogeneity inputs.
